decisions.reason: This looks like a renamed and improved version of an already accepted trommel screen, so an established machinery maker would normally continue it rather than withdraw it after one year.
A newly launched multi-model shredder line with its own webpage fits the firm's core mobile processing business and is likely to be given time to build market traction.
Although only mentioned briefly on the website, a mobile high-speed grinder is close to the firm's core applications and would usually be retained while sales and field experience develop.
The stationary electric fine shredder is more niche and less prominently presented, but it matches the firm's push toward efficient and resource-saving processing solutions.

This green-waste grinder variant appears less emphasized and somewhat specialized, yet it still serves a core customer segment in composting and biomass so management would likely keep it on the market.
A stationary single-shaft pre-shredder line with several models and its own product page fits the firm's established shredding portfolio and is unlikely to be pulled quickly.
